description: Ex-FAB AMX A-1A 5524 displayed at the private Museu EPCAR Turma 73/AFA/76 in the grounds of the Vale das Nuvens hotel (opened 2019, enlarged Mar 2022; paid entry, open daily, visitors may board the aircraft); serial per Feb 2026 AeroEntusiasta compilation.

Ex-FAB Xavante at the Museu EPCAR; the Feb 2026 compilation gives 4570, but the same number is quoted for Recife (BARF interior) and Porto Velho, so it is treated as painted and the tail left blank (Pass 2 did the same).
Ex-FAB UH-1H acquired by the museum (museum 'Reportagens' page: 'Adquirimos mais uma aeronave, o Bell UH-1H'); serial per Feb 2026 compilation.
Ex-FAB Neiva T-25 Universal 1961 at the Museu EPCAR; serial per Feb 2026 compilation.
